faqs.question: What age range is Little Joys Calcium Gummies suitable for?
faqs.answer: Our Calcium Gummies are ideal for every child of age 2-12 years

faqs.question: How many gummies are there in one pack of Little Joys Calcium Gummies?
faqs.answer: A single pack of Little Joys Calcium Gummies contains 30 gummies

faqs.question: How many gummies should my child eat every day?
faqs.answer: If your kid is 2-6 years old, we recommend taking one gummy a day. If your kid is above 7, we recommend taking two gummies a day. Each gummy has been created to help fill daily nutritional gaps and includes the highest-quality nutrients available in forms that your body prefers and can easily digest.

faqs.question: For how long does my child need to take calcium gummies?
faqs.answer: We recommend taking Little Joys Multivitamin Gummies for 3 months to see results.

faqs.question: Are these gummies bad for my child's teeth?
faqs.answer: Little Joys Gummies are made with natural sweeteners and contain no added sugars, making them a healthier choice than regular gummies. However, like all gummies, they can stick to teeth and may contribute to cavities if good oral hygiene isn't followed. For best dental health, don't give more than 1-2 gummies in a day and encourage your child to brush or rinse their mouth after eating.
